plain: Containing a written statement that harms someone's good name.

webster.text: Defamatory; containing that which exposes a person to public hatred, contempt and ridicule; as a libelous pamphlet or picture.

example.quote: Is, then, the federal government, it will be asked, destitute of every authority for restraining the licentiousness of the press, and for shielding ​itself against the libelous attacks which may be made on those who administer it?
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
